notes.title: Liegecraft on Tacticon 2025
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258346/f0c32e7dabea9158f9e4571a0947f06a38c4ee2d.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone! We’re thrilled to be part of [b]#TactiCon [/b]this week! If you’re seeing the game for the first time, welcome! If you fancy 4X games and love to role play - Liegecraft might be something for you![/p][p]If you like the game - please wishlist - it will mean world to us! If you’ve been following us for a while, thank you for sticking around.[/p][p]It’s been a while since our last post — we’ve been heads-down, grinding on internal builds and milestones crucial for the project.[/p][p]Unfortunately, that hasn’t left much room for public updates — but we’ll do our best to improve that going forward. We’ll have more to share when the time is right.[/p][p][/p][p]For now, we’re happy to be visible again! [/p]

notes.title: 📜DEVLOG #2 Marta Draws Swedish Vassal
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today we want to share with you a brand new devlog episode! 

This time Marta has created a timelapse with commentary when she was drawing a new illustration for one of the swedish vassals.

Characters in our game will have randomized properties so we cannot really say this is a specific person, but while making this illustration we Internally we gave him name #MAGNUS ːsteamhappyː Enjoy!

[previewyoutube=u35G5UvPMr4;full][/previewyoutube]

--------------------
[h2]About DEVLOGS ⤵️[/h2]

This format allows us to give you a deeper understanding of what Liegecraft is, exploring its key mechanics and features to align with your expectations. Since Liegecraft is a community-driven project, we’re committed to keeping you in the loop with weekly devlogs! ✍️

Also we want this format to suit your preferences as much as possible, so we’re looking forward to your feedback and suggestions for future topics, format improvement etc. 

PS. We have been over-optimistic with our velocity on creating devlogs, we've initially planned to release one per week, but we are loosening that up since we value more quality of what we deliver to you than quantity. We'll do our best to share them as frequently as possible ✍️

notes.title: Official Reveal! ✅
notes.content:
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1503170/Liegecraft/]Liegecraft[/url] [/b]is a [b]medieval turn-based sandbox 4X blend with RPG[/b]. You are a monarch, command your vassals of various personalities to build a feudal realm of prosperity! 👑
[previewyoutube=Hk-2Mu8bvKY;full][/previewyoutube] Reward the loyal with power, land and royal titles, scheme against rivals and imprison the disobedient. And when diplomacy fails, lead massive armies into epic battles or resolve matters in one-on-one duels...
[hr][/hr][h3][b]READ MORE ABOUT [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1503170/Liegecraft/]LIEGECRAFT[/url] ⤵️[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1503170/Liegecraft/
[hr][/hr]Welcome Counts, Dukes and Barons gathered here! I'm [b]Tomek[/b] [b]- Game Director[/b] of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1503170/Liegecraft/]Liegecraft[/url]. It is a very important day for us and a start of a new chapter of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1503170/Liegecraft/]Liegecraft[/url] development journey. But from now on - we will not be alone anymore! ːsteamhappyː

We are thrilled that you will be part of further development of our game. You can be sure that we will stay in close touch with you, update on dev progress, host playtests, share devlogs and ask for your feedback. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1503170/Liegecraft/]Liegecraft[/url] is a our own blend of strategy and RPG. We love character-based games and we love some good strategy. We are addicted 'one-more-turn' guys & gals. We exploit resources till the last stone and don't give up on that damn valley we really want to conquer. 
[hr][/hr][i]If you liked [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1503170/Liegecraft/]Liegecraft[/url] so far - be sure to wishlist & follow us on social media so you can stay up to date will all the info.
